verses.text: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

segments.text: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth;
For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.text: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

segments.text: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor:
With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

verses.text: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;

segments.text: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips,
The tongue that speaketh great things;

verses.text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

segments.text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail;
Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.text: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

segments.text: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy,
Now will I arise, saith Jehovah;
I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

verses.text: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.

segments.text: The words of Jehovah are pure words;
As silver tried in a furnace on the earth,

verses.text: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

segments.text: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah,
Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.text: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

segments.text: The wicked walk on every side,
When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
